source: Built from the v.272 research (21–23 Nov 2026) and Nexon's Challenger World notice. Items marked unconfirmed have a reset pill you can switch.

items.label: Claim the Ultima Supply Report and Challenger rewards
items.note: One Supply Report claim per account per day. Take the day's three 3x EXP coupons too; 15 of them trade for one 4x.

items.label: Pop a 3x EXP coupon, then start the grind
items.note: Stack a 4x coupon or VIP buff if you have one.

items.label: Cernium daily: 30 Cernium symbols
items.note: Your grind block. The same kills fill event kill counters and the weekly hunts. Heroic gives 30 a day (MapleStory Wiki).

items.label: Shadow Supplies activations
items.note: Each needs 500 kills near your level and summons a box of EXP.

items.label: Hotel Arcus daily: 15 Arcus symbols
items.note: Opens at Lv. 265 after the Arcus questline.

items.label: Ursus: one run
items.note: One run a day since v.272 (was three), with meso rewards tripled and Golden Time always on (Nexon v.272 patch notes, 10 Nov 2026; checked 23 Nov 2026). About 90M a day on Heroic is a community estimate.

items.label: Daily bosses
items.empty: Pick your daily bosses on Bosses
items.note: The daily bosses you picked on Bosses. One tick per clear: the same tick as on Bosses.

items.label: Use 3 Arcane Seal wands
items.note: Resets daily at 00:00 UTC (Nexon). Up to 20 wands can be held.

items.label: Spend new Training Cards
items.note: Combat: Normal Enemy Damage, then Boss Damage, IED and ATT. Special: Grandis daily rewards, Monster Park clear EXP.

items.label: Start Luxe Sauna when you log off
items.note: Coupons only: 30 min of AFK EXP each, up to 48 h a week; the weekly limit resets Wednesday 00:00 UTC (v.272 notes).

items.label: Gollux
items.note: Long-term source of Superior Gollux accessories.

items.label: Monster Park Sweep with leftover free tickets
items.note: EXP only. Read the prompt so the Sweep doesn't spend Maple Points.

items.label: Arcane River dailies
items.note: Only while your Arcane symbols need levels and you have the mesos to fuse them.

items.label: Sunny Sunday: read the perk before spending mesos
items.note: Sunday 09:00 KST to Monday 08:59 KST. Hold big cube or Star Force spends for a discount Sunday.

items.label: Challenger World weekly progression missions
items.note: Progress resets every Wednesday at 00:00 UTC (Nexon's Challenger World notice).

items.label: Specter Blast
items.note: 2-player weekly EXP. Its weekly EXP limit resets Wednesday 00:00 UTC (v.272 notes). Skip it if matchmaking is slow.

items.label: Weekly bosses
items.note: Cleared this week out of the weekly bosses you picked. Tick clears on the Bosses page or on Today; Bosses tracks your 14-crystal cap and income.

items.label: Challenger Pass weekly missions
items.note: Up to 500 points a week; resets Thursday 00:00 UTC (Nexon).

items.label: Item Burning Plus hunt: 2,000 kills for 100 crests
items.note: Monsters within 20 levels. Resets Thursday 00:00 UTC (Nexon).

items.label: Normal Kai
items.note: Challenger World only, solo. No crystal. The same tick as Kai on Bosses.

items.label: Mayrin (from Lv. 270)
items.note: Season boss, once a week per account. Golden Meso Pouches, +3% ATT soul. The same tick as Mayrin on Bosses.

items.label: Shadow Bounties shop
items.note: 4x EXP coupons (500 Basic, 2 a week), Symbol Selector Coupons (100 Basic), then Karma Bright Cubes (Heroic gets no Bonus Bright).

items.label: Arthur's Equipment Rental before a real boss attempt
items.note: Lasts 2 days, up to 3 a week, paid in mesos first.

groups.title: Reset day unconfirmed
groups.hint: tap the pill to match the in-game timer

items.label: Extreme Monster Parker: 5 Monster Park clears
items.note: Sweep with free tickets only. Up to 2 characters per world.

items.label: Ultima weekly hunt: 2,000 kills
items.note: 800 Alliance Credit plus Training Cards each.

items.label: Etherion Relics: 10,000 kills
items.note: Probably Wednesday; one more completion unlocks each week, up to 12.

items.label: Epic Dungeon: High Mountain at base reward
items.note: Skip the 5x and 9x multipliers (7,500 and 30,000 Maple Points).

fieldsNote: Item fields: "scope": "account" = ticked once for the whole account (the item's note says so); "only": "challenger" = shown only for Challenger World characters (named in Nexon's Challenger World notice, id 47305, or in the item's own text); "minLevel" = locked below that level (Cernium 260 and Arcus 265 are the symbol areas' unlock levels in symbols.json; Mayrin 270 is in Nexon's notice). One record per boss clear (the ticks on the Bosses page): "bosses": "daily" or "weekly" = the row follows the bosses of that reset picked on Bosses ("empty" is its text while none is picked); "boss": [ids from bosses.json] = the row is that boss's own tick on Bosses.
